description: This PHP class 'BesselY' provides calculations for the Bessel function of the second kind, including specific cases for orders 0 and 1, and handles array inputs as well as error cases. It is part of the PhpOffice PhpSpreadsheet library under the Calculation/Engineering namespace.

classes.name: BesselY
classes.description: A PHP class for calculating Bessel functions of the second kind, supporting various orders and array inputs, within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

methods.name: BesselY::BESSELY
methods.description: Public static method to compute the Bessel Y function for given input and order, with validation and support for array inputs.

methods.name: BesselY::calculate
methods.description: Private helper method to select specific calculations based on order.

methods.name: BesselY::callBesselJ
methods.description: Private method to call external Bessel J function, with type safety.

methods.name: BesselY::besselY0
methods.description: Computes the Bessel Y function of order 0 for a given x.

methods.name: BesselY::besselY1
methods.description: Computes the Bessel Y function of order 1 for a given x.

methods.name: BesselY::besselY2
methods.description: Computes the Bessel Y function for higher orders using recurrence.
